id: Create or update an External Issue
name: Create or update an external issue from an integration platform integration.
description: Create or update an external issue from an integration platform integration. POST /api/0/sentry-app-installations/{uuid}/external-issues/
context:
POST /api/0/sentry-app-installations/{uuid}/external-issues/
Create or update an external issue from an integration platform integration.

name: Delete an external issue.
context:
DELETE /api/0/sentry-app-installations/{uuid}/external-issues/{external_issue_id}/
Delete an external issue.
Required: uuid (path) — The uuid of the integration platform integration.; external_issue_id (path) — The ID of the external issue.

name: Create or Link an External Issue Through a Sentry App
description: Create or Link an External Issue Through a Sentry App **Experimental:** This API is under active development and may change. POST /api/0/sentry-app-installations/{uuid}/external-issue-actions/
context:
POST /api/0/sentry-app-installations/{uuid}/external-issue-actions/
**Experimental:** This API is under active development and may change. Invoke the installed app's issue-link callback and store the returned association. Submit the app-specific form fields alongside `groupId`, `action`, and `uri`.
Required: uuid (path) — The UUID of the Sentry App installation.; body (body)

name: Retrieve a Sentry App's Select Field Options
description: Retrieve a Sentry App's Select Field Options **Experimental:** This API is under active development and may change. GET /api/0/sentry-app-installations/{uuid}/external-requests/
context:
GET /api/0/sentry-app-installations/{uuid}/external-requests/
**Experimental:** This API is under active development and may change. Request select options from the installed app. Each choice contains its value followed by its label.
Required: uuid (path) — The UUID of the Sentry App installation.; uri (query) — The relative URI of the select field's options callback.
Optional: projectId (query) — The Sentry project ID to include in the options request.; query (query) — The search text for select options.; dependentData (query) — A JSON-encoded object containing the values of fields this select depends on.
